summary: Underneath it, a need to be seen and to matter and deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe flow together so easily you can take it for granted. It comes naturally — you shine and lead without trying and you read people and care on instinct — which is exactly why it's easy to coast on.
body: Underneath it, a need to be seen and to matter and deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe flow together so easily you can take it for granted. It comes naturally — you shine and lead without trying and you read people and care on instinct — which is exactly why it's easy to coast on. Self-direction reads as either steady and integrated, or as internal conflict that undercuts decisiveness. Your outer direction and inner needs may support each other more easily here. What you want can feel aligned with what helps you feel safe.
gift: At your best: you shine and lead without trying, and you read people and care on instinct.
shadow: The trap: you make it all about you, or you shrink when no one's looking — or your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need.
integration: Let identity and emotional needs cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Self-direction reads as either steady and integrated, or as internal conflict that undercuts decisiveness.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you shine and you read people work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: You make it all about you
Let the reflex make the decision
